column1: # How the player moves without the boat, per port.  EDIT ME.
# Sailing moves the boat.  This file is everything else: charter ships and
# teleports, which move the *player* and leave the boat where it was.  That is
# what makes scouting possible - you go and read boards, then rejoin the boat.
#   charter        y = a charter ship serves this port.  Sourced from the wiki
#                  (oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Charter_ship), which lists 21
#                  destinations.  Fares run 200-5,200 gp; the wiki says travel
#                  "takes only a few seconds".
#   charter_req    what gates the charter destination, blank if nothing.
#   teleport       best-known magic or item teleport landing at or near the
#                  port.  UNVERIFIED - I have not confirmed these against the
#                  game and several are a short walk from the dock rather than
#                  on it.  Correct them.
#   walk_ticks     ticks from where the teleport lands to the gangplank.
#   ticks          total player-travel time.  ALL PLACEHOLDERS - nobody has
#                  timed any of this.  Charter is written as 10 ticks (6s) on
#                  the wiki's "a few seconds"; treat every number as a guess
#                  until measured.
# Only ports with dock_level <= 30 are listed.  Add rows as the level rises.
